jerk_definition: mean squared 2nd difference of the commanded force vector per control tick (jerk_proxy). Gate is a POST-HOC tag when AEGIS_GATE unset; when AEGIS_GATE=inloop, the Tier-4 gate intercepts physically inside the control loop: veto >0.618 jerk -> retract 3cm for 4 ticks with KP*0.3, then resume at same arclength.
